app.name: Spotify
app.description: A digital music, podcast, and video streaming service that provides access to millions of songs and other content from creators worldwide.

notes: Tested: a custom auth config created without `oauth_redirect_uri` sends `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add`. Register exactly the URI your auth config sends, or set `oauth_redirect_uri` to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` and register that instead.
Composio does not provide a default OAuth app for Spotify; you must create your own in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

Composio automatically sends default scopes including `user-read-private`, `user-read-email`, `app-remote-control`, `streaming`, `user-modify-playback-state`, `user-read-playback-state`, and `user-read-currently-playing`.

assumption: An agent that plays, searches, or manages playback and user libraries in any user's Spotify account

verdict.headline: Spotify requires an active business entity with 250k+ MAUs for production app access, and prohibits AI training on API data.
verdict.summary: Development mode requires a Spotify Premium account and is strictly capped at 5 test users, which are allowlisted by email. Moving past this limit requires entering Extended Quota Mode, which is gated behind stringent business criteria and a manual review process that takes up to six weeks. Furthermore, the developer terms explicitly forbid using Spotify content to train AI or machine learning models.

handsOnEffort.label: 1–2 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: Dashboard app registration and redirect URL configuration take minutes; test user allowlisting is manual.

timeToFirstConnection.label: Immediate
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Self-serve registration in the developer dashboard allows immediate local testing with allowlisted premium accounts.

timeToProduction.label: 6 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Spotify states review and approval take up to 6 weeks once business requirements and form criteria are met.

verdict.longestPole: Extended Quota Mode eligibility (requires an established business entity with at least 250,000 MAUs) and the subsequent 6-week review process.
verdict.costDetail: Developer dashboard access is free, but development mode requires a personal Spotify Premium account.

easierPaths.condition: Keeping the integration strictly to 5 or fewer users
easierPaths.effect: Stays in Development Mode without needing business verification or Extended Quota approval.

factors.detail: Anyone can register an app instantly via the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Moving to Extended Quota Mode requires submitting an application and undergoing a review process.
Extended Quota Mode requires an established business entity operating an active launched service.
No formal third-party security assessment or penetration test is explicitly required, though strict terms apply.
API access does not require a paid developer subscription fee.
Access is handled via online application forms rather than a direct sales contract negotiation.
Development Mode is capped at a maximum of 5 authorized test users.
Standard OAuth workflow applies per user without custom per-customer enterprise configuration.

phases.title: Register your Spotify Developer App
phases.outcome: A registered Spotify app with a Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Sign in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard
steps.details: Go to the [Spotify Developer Dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard) and log in using your Spotify account. Note that the app owner account must be a Spotify Premium account [S17].

steps.title: Create your application
steps.details: In the dashboard, click **Create an App**. Enter your **App Name** and **App Description**, accept the Developer Terms of Service, and save [S2].
steps.agentAssist: Draft your app name and description and prepare the exact use case text required during registration.

phases.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Scopes
phases.outcome: Callback URLs and OAuth parameters properly configured in your app settings.

steps.title: Configure redirect URIs
steps.details: Open your app settings in the dashboard. Navigate to **Settings** and add `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add` (or `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`) to your **Redirect URIs** list. Click **Save**.
steps.agentAssist: Provide the exact Composio callback URLs to the developer for pasting into the console.

steps.title: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret
steps.details: Retrieve your **Client ID** and **Client Secret** from your app dashboard overview page. Store them securely for configuring Composio.

phases.title: Test in Development Mode
phases.outcome: Working local connections for up to 5 allowlisted users.

steps.title: Allowlist test users by email
steps.details: In your app dashboard, go to **Users and Access** and add the email addresses of up to 5 authorized test users. All test users must have a Spotify Premium account [S10, S17].
steps.agentAssist: Collect test user emails and format them for allowlisting.

phases.title: Prepare for Extended Quota Mode (Production)
phases.outcome: Meeting the strict 250k MAU business criteria required for public apps.

steps.title: Verify business entity and MAU threshold
steps.details: Confirm that your application is operated by an established business entity, runs an active launched service, and meets or exceeds 250,000 monthly active users (MAUs) [S21].
steps.agentAssist: Draft a summary of user metrics and business documentation to support the Extended Quota application.

steps.title: Submit the Extended Quota Form
steps.details: Submit your application via the official Google Form link provided in the Spotify Quota Modes documentation. Wait up to six weeks for review once submitted [S10, S21].
steps.agentAssist: Review form fields and draft responses explaining your service architecture and compliance.

phases.title: Go live in Composio
phases.outcome: Spotify fully connected and ready for automated agent actions via Composio.

steps.title: Create Custom OAuth2 Auth Config in Composio
steps.details: Use Composio's API to create a custom OAuth2 auth config for the `spotify` toolkit, providing your Client ID, Client Secret, and redirect URI `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add` [P2].
steps.agentAssist: Execute the API call to register your custom OAuth app credentials with Composio.

steps.title: Initiate connection in Composio
steps.details: Start a connection session using the custom auth config. Composio sends users to `https://accounts.spotify.com/authorize` with PKCE enabled and default scopes (`user-read-private`, `user-read-email`, `app-remote-control`, `streaming`, `user-modify-playback-state`, `user-read-playback-state`, `user-read-currently-playing`) [P2].
steps.agentAssist: Trigger the auth flow link and handle the user consent callback.

requirements.detail: Sign in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard to create and manage client credentials.
The app owner must hold a Spotify Premium account for development mode usage.
Up to 5 test users must be explicitly allowlisted by email in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Extended Quota Mode requires an established business entity running an active service with at least 250,000 MAUs.

scopes.purpose: Read access to user's subscription details and personal data.
Read access to user's email address.
Control playback of Spotify audio on client applications.
Control user's playback state (play, pause, skip, seek).
Read user's current playback state and active device.
Read what content is currently playing on the user's device.
Remote control playback of Spotify audio.

blockers.title: Development Mode User Cap Reached
blockers.symptom: Non-allowlisted test users get authentication errors or cannot connect to the app.
blockers.howToProceed: Add the user's email explicitly under **Users and Access** in the Spotify Developer Dashboard, ensuring they hold a Spotify Premium account.

blockers.title: Extended Quota Mode Rejected or Gated
blockers.symptom: Applications with fewer than 250k MAUs or non-business entities are denied Extended Quota access.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure your service meets the active MAU criteria and business entity requirement introduced in May 2025 before reapplying.

blockers.title: AI Training Terms Violation
blockers.symptom: Account or API access suspended for ingesting Spotify data into machine learning models.
blockers.howToProceed: Review Spotify's Developer Terms; strictly ensure that no Spotify content or API data is used to train AI or machine learning models.

nuances.title: PKCE Requirement
nuances.detail: Spotify endpoints support authorization code flow with PKCE (S256), which Composio handles automatically during connection flows.

nuances.title: AI Training Prohibited
nuances.detail: Spotify Developer Terms explicitly prohibit using the Spotify Platform or any Spotify Content to train a machine learning or AI model.

nuances.title: Development Mode Restrictions
nuances.detail: Development mode limits each developer to 1 Client ID and a maximum of 5 allowlisted test users who must hold a Premium subscription.

steps: Create your app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard and obtain your Client ID and Client Secret.
Add `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add` as a Redirect URI in your Spotify app settings.
Configure a custom OAuth2 auth config in Composio for the `spotify` toolkit using your Client ID and Client Secret.
Initiate an authentication flow through Composio using the custom auth config ID.
